correctness.rationale: For k>=2,n>=1, height-t section of the cube–simplex Cayley polytope is n copies of K_t=(1−t)[0,1]^k+tΔ_k and n copies of K_(1−t). The subset-sum halfspaces are necessary; decomposing z into min(z_i,1−t) and (z_i−(1−t))_+ proves sufficiency. Each lower, upper-subset and height inequality defines an irredundant facet by a relative-interior dimension argument, giving 2n(2^k+k−1)+2 facets. Lower-coordinate and both full-set facet distances bound radius by (k+1)/(2(k+sqrt(k²−k+1))); equality forces t=1/2 and each block coordinate to equal r. Monotonicity of r_s verifies all subset barriers and 2n(k+1) tangent facets. Boolean-complement pairs give diameter sqrt(2kn+1) and (k+1)^(2n) diameter pairs; fiber volume V_k(t)=Σbinom(k,j)(1−t)^(k−j)t^j/j! gives exact integral. For k=2, Laplace around t=1/2 yields (7sqrt(pi)/(6sqrt(2n)))(49/64)^n. Independent k=2,n=1 and k=3,n=1 exact vertex/facet/LP and complement tests reproduced 12 and 22 facets and radii 0.40192378865 and 0.35424868894.
